v3.0.0 Update
v3.0.0 adds a GM token list, Starfinder 2e support, and optional action and movement tracking. It also fixes token-specific End Turn, personal category items, player Item drops, effect updates, and scrolling.
The GM List keeps a private token roster for each scene, with compact cards that expand on hover. Personal HUD mode keeps an owned, assigned character visible when it is in the roster.
Move and resize the HUD on screen, or mirror the Party HUD and Action Menu independently across all eight themes. Direct layout changes are saved only for you.
Search all visible categories together, hide empty categories, choose icons from a picker, and open item sheets with Shift + right-click.
Tooltips summarize spells, weapons, armor, healing, and checks. Spell rows show durations; Inventory shows attunement or investment counts. D&D5e Tools follows 2014 and 2024 rules.
Starfinder 2e now supports attacks, spells, skills, inventory, and resources. PF2e and SF2e share ammunition controls and manual spending; Area Fire and Auto-Fire do not gain automatic ammo consumption.
Enable optional PF2e and SF2e action tracking in Action Menu settings, with reactions, undo, skill actions, and explicit macro cost reports. Optional movement tracking shows remaining distance and spends actions using Speed. Combat action tracking is off by default.

announcement.title: ⚔️ Stylish Action HUD v3.0.0
announcement.content:
v3.0.0 adds a GM token list, Starfinder 2e support, and optional action and movement tracking. It also fixes token-specific End Turn, personal category items, player Item drops, effect updates, and scrolling.

  • The GM List keeps a private token roster for each scene, with compact cards that expand on hover. Personal HUD mode keeps an owned, assigned character visible when it is in the roster.
  • Move and resize the HUD on screen, or mirror the Party HUD and Action Menu independently across all eight themes. Direct layout changes are saved only for you.
  • Search all visible categories together, hide empty categories, choose icons from a picker, and open item sheets with Shift + right-click.
  • Tooltips summarize spells, weapons, armor, healing, and checks. Spell rows show durations; Inventory shows attunement or investment counts. D&D5e Tools follows 2014 and 2024 rules.
  • Starfinder 2e now supports attacks, spells, skills, inventory, and resources. PF2e and SF2e share ammunition controls and manual spending; Area Fire and Auto-Fire do not gain automatic ammo consumption.
  • Enable optional PF2e and SF2e action tracking in Action Menu settings, with reactions, undo, skill actions, and explicit macro cost reports. Optional movement tracking shows remaining distance and spends actions using Speed. Combat action tracking is off by default.
